description: Java class implementing interest calculation logic for fixed deposit accounts within Fineract environment. It validates input data, extracts parameters from JSON, and calculates interest based on compound interest formulas.

classes.name: FixedDepositAccountInterestCalculationServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of interest calculation service for fixed deposit accounts, providing methods to compute maturity amount based on account parameters.

methods.name: calculateInterest()
methods.description: Calculates the maturity amount for a fixed deposit based on input JSON query, returning a map with the amount and a warning message.

methods.name: calculateInterestInternal()
methods.description: Performs the core compound interest calculation based on principal, interest rate, tenure, and compounding period.
